lines.text: Here's how to answer a problem, one step at a time.
Type your first step in the box, the way you'd write it on paper.
The keys under the box type powers, roots and brackets for you. Handy on a phone.
Press Enter, or tap the check mark, to check it.
Each step gets a note: it's right, or what to look at again.
When a line is the answer, the problem is done. You can finish on any line.
